# Breathizen

> Breathizen is a Respiratory & Lung Support Supplement (liquid drops). Breathizen is a once-daily liquid respiratory support formula sold through its official website. Each serving delivers a 154 mg botanical blend built around Mullein, Ginger and Organic Lemon — a trio traditionally used to support clear, comfortable breathing and everyday respiratory wellness. Because it is a liquid drop formula rather than a capsule, it is taken quickly, with no pills to swallow, and can be added to water or taken directly. Bottles start at $49 and every order is backed by a 60-day money-back guarantee, so you can give the formula a fair trial before deciding whether it earns a place in your routine.
